claim_scope: Depth one, standard three-reference-observation AUGUST signed product under independent continuous sampling; fixed positive fraction for each sample.
integrity: The exact algebra is checked using rational arithmetic; asymptotic conclusions follow from bounded two-sample U-statistics and an ordinary central limit theorem. No independent verification is claimed.
scientific_limitations: No claim for other binary depths, alternate subsample sizes, two-sided/vector tests, or finite-n power estimates.
Historical priority has not undergone independent audit.
title: A sign-reversal obstruction for depth-one AUGUST two-sample testing
